Lines not through $O$ and not in $H$ project bijectively onto a line of $H$, so their sums vanish. Each nonzero point of $c'$ yields exactly $q$ nonzero points of $c$, so $\mathrm{wt}(c)=q\,\mathrm{wt}(c')$. Iterating gives $d(n,q)\le q^{n-2}d(2,q)$.
